description: Decompose a distinguished name into its components, relative distinguished names, bare values, attribute/value pairs, an associative case-insensitive grouping, and scalar views (leftmost value, leftmost attribute, leftmost component, and parent). A malformed input yields empty collections and scalar views.

cases.expected_output:
components=[]
rdns=[]
values=[]
multi=[]
assoc=[]
name=
head=
relative=
parent=

components=["dc=com"]
rdns=["dc=com"]
values=["com"]
multi=[["dc","com"]]
assoc={"dc":["com"]}
name=com
head=dc
relative=dc=com
parent=

components=["cn=foo\\2bsn\\3dbar"]
rdns=["cn=foo+sn=bar"]
values=["foo+sn=bar"]
multi=[["cn","foo+sn=bar"]]
assoc={"cn":["foo+sn=bar"]}
name=foo+sn=bar
head=cn
relative=cn=foo\2bsn\3dbar
parent=

components=["CN=Foo","DC=Bar"]
rdns=["CN=Foo","DC=Bar"]
values=["Foo","Bar"]
multi=[["CN","Foo"],["DC","Bar"]]
assoc={"cn":["Foo"],"dc":["Bar"]}
name=Foo
head=CN
relative=CN=Foo
parent=DC=Bar

components=["ou=a","ou=b","ou=c","dc=d"]
rdns=["ou=a","ou=b","ou=c","dc=d"]
values=["a","b","c","d"]
multi=[["ou","a"],["ou","b"],["ou","c"],["dc","d"]]
assoc={"ou":["a","b","c"],"dc":["d"]}
name=a
head=ou
relative=ou=a
parent=ou=b,ou=c,dc=d

components=["cn=a\\2bb"]
rdns=["cn=a\\2Bb"]
values=["a+b"]
multi=[["cn","a\\2Bb"]]
assoc={"cn":["a\\2Bb"]}
name=a+b
head=cn
relative=cn=a\2bb
